name: Wing & Wind
source:
From an invitation from his cousin, who lives in a small village close to a mountain,
our main character uses his vacation time to go visit the village.
Here, he meets eternal life, or in other words, the heroine, who carries the destiny of
both never growing old and never dying. For the price of eternal life, the heroine is always avoided, the outcast, the outsider. Even with this life of solitude, our heroine leads a happy and bright life. Around this girl are her cousins,
a very quiet girl, and a priestess. The simple, ordinary life of our hero is slowly being changed by meeting these girls. 

[Modified from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20020613201621fw_/http://gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2001/a/wing_wind/index.htm]gamelexgs[/url]]
translation:
主人公收到住在山边小村的表亲邀请，利用假期前往村庄拜访。
在那里，他遇见了永恒的生命——换言之，就是背负着永不衰老、永不死亡命运的女主角。作为永生的代价，她总被他人回避，是个遭排斥的局外人。尽管孤独生活，她仍过得开朗而幸福。陪伴在女孩身边的还有她的表亲、一名非常安静的女孩，以及一位巫女。与这些女孩相遇后，主人公简单平凡的生活开始逐渐改变。

[修改自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20020613201621fw_/http://gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2001/a/wing_wind/index.htm]Gamelexgs[/url]]
